Messages.Body:
Chris Shorb & Tammy Martin wrote:
>
> I feel that this is a dumb question, but it came up in our
> league, so I must ask it:
>
> Can a player use multiple maneuver cards in a row? I.e. can
> I Flash, Flash, .44 without the opposing player playing any
> maneuver cards?
>
> I felt no, since the text in the rulebook clearly says
> "cancel maneuvers", which I would take to mean play a
> maneuver to cancel the other player's maneuver. Can you
> cancel your own?

No.
Also, you cannot cancel your own presses.
